local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the 12 test classes, the generated library metadata (53 reflection, 3 resource entries) and the test-only split (46 reflection entries). All metadata is agent-generated; the single lambda typeReached condition was rewritten by fix_lambda. Library entries are conditioned on spring-boot classes and cover binder array/collection creation, ApplicationConversionService optional-type probes, SpringApplication spring.factories listeners and initializers, LoggingSystem selection, EnvironmentConverter and Atomikos depends-on detection. No Gradle, JUnit or test-only types leak into the library file. Dynamic access coverage is 19/29 (65.5%). All three native lanes (GraalVM 25, latest, latest future-defaults-all), checkstyle and spotlessCheck pass. Dropped scenarios: full SpringApplication.run startups (main-class deduction, BeanDefinitionLoader class-name sources, ClearCachesApplicationListener, constructor-bound @ConfigurationProperties, FailureAnalyzers) because native-image-configure generate-conditional discards the Instantiator-created EnvironmentPostProcessor and ConfigData reflection (configuration propagated to call-tree nodes removed by the user-code filter is lost), so the agent cannot produce metadata that makes them pass natively; NoSuchMethodFailureAnalyzer, which needs .class resources and a CodeSource; package-name BeanDefinitionLoader sources, which need classpath .class scanning that Spring 5.3 ASM cannot read for Java 25 classes.
